blind_rmse.zh: 同构型内1次随机重复的强弱源RMSE，纵轴对数，竖线为逐项bootstrap 95%区间；真值初始图仅作局部诊断。
blind_rmse.en: Source-wise RMSE on 1 paired realizations per fixed geometry; log y-axis, pointwise bootstrap 95% intervals. Truth-initialized results are local diagnostics only.

truth_local_rmse.zh: 同构型内1次随机重复的强弱源RMSE，纵轴对数，竖线为逐项bootstrap 95%区间；真值初始图仅作局部诊断。
truth_local_rmse.en: Source-wise RMSE on 1 paired realizations per fixed geometry; log y-axis, pointwise bootstrap 95% intervals. Truth-initialized results are local diagnostics only.

local_mse_decomposition.zh: 真值初始局部诊断的弱源MSE分解：样本平均位移平方加中心波动均方。前者不能直接当作真实系统偏差。
local_mse_decomposition.en: Exact sample MSE decomposition for the weak source in local diagnostics; squared sample mean is not a known population bias.
